summary: Canonical ontology contract for the Prompt Vault v2 facet cutover.
classification_rules: routers classify as artifact_kind=procedure and control_mode=router
iterative orchestrators classify as artifact_kind=procedure and control_mode=loop
workflow belongs to formalization_level, never to artifact_kind or control_mode
legacy prompt_templates.type is not a governing ontology axis in v2
formalization_level=workflow means workflow-grade specification, not automatic workflow_execute runtime binding
artifact_kind=session is reserved until positively defined; session-related reusable action prompts normally classify as artifact_kind=procedure
runtime executor selection belongs in an explicit execution_binding/orchestration_contract, not in artifact_kind, control_mode, formalization_level, owner_company, visibility, or template name

seed_prompts.name: analysis-router
seed_prompts.purpose: Route outputs from deep analysis prompts into the single best next operating mode and emit the exact next prompt.

seed_prompts.name: post-review-router
seed_prompts.purpose: Take review findings and convert them into the next exact prompt for action.

seed_prompts.name: review-closeout-router
seed_prompts.purpose: Close the review loop by selecting the best final next mode and exact prompt.

golden_queries.description: No seed prompt uses workflow as a prompt kind
golden_queries.rule: workflow may appear only in formalization_level

artifact_kind.question: What kind of reusable Prompt Vault information artifact is this?

values.cognitive: A reusable cognitive lens or reasoning frame.
values.procedure: A reusable prompt/procedure that prescribes action or routing.
values.session: Reserved legacy value; do not use for live sessions, session JSONL, transcripts, receipts, diary/learnings, evidence-ledger rows, or one-off runtime context until a narrower session-scaffold contract is introduced.

control_mode.question: What control topology does the prompt impose?

values.one_shot: Single-pass application or bounded procedure body.
values.router: Selects a next prompt/procedure and emits an exact transition rather than executing downstream work.
values.loop: Iterative or phase-gated control topology that requires loop semantics when executed.

formalization_level.question: How fully specified is the prompt artifact?

values.structured: Structured prompt with stable sections or output expectations.
values.workflow: Workflow-grade specification; not by itself a binding to workflow_execute or any runtime executor.
